packet_dag.terminal_condition: Rabbi / One Time provider portal has a scoped mailbox MVP that lists and opens email threads from bna_communications, saves local reply drafts, and can send only through the guarded Resend sender path when readiness and explicit confirmation pass.

title: One Time CRM Mailbox MVP

reasons: Operator asked for a real Rabbi mailbox instead of a fake CRM/inquiry tray.
Operator used product-quality language including CRM and multi-million dollar quality.
Email receiving and reply sending involve external-provider readiness, privacy, and explicit-send approval rules.
The immediate implementation can stay scoped to one major module: One Time provider mailbox.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Production live inbound capture requires RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET for /api/resend/inbound.
Production reply sending requires Resend sender readiness for info@onetimeonetime.com and explicit confirmation.
Bulk broadcast email is out of scope and requires a separate campaign packet with unsubscribe/suppression/list-source proof.
Physical mailing address must be configured in runtime env/keyholder and not committed to tracked files.

operator_intent_summary: Build Rabbi a real One Time CRM mailbox for info@onetimeonetime.com so he can log in, see emails, open threads, and use a guarded reply workflow inside the first-party provider portal.
raw_quotes: He wants to just log into his email and see it.
Can you just build that for me right now?
Let's give him a CRM. Let's give him the inbox.
Like a really nice one. Like a multi-million dollar CRM inbox.
There's already a Rabbi list, but he wants to see his inbox.

decisions_captured.decision: The physical mailing address is approved by the operator for future email compliance footer use but must be stored in runtime config, not tracked source.
Bulk broadcast sending is a later guarded packet; this packet builds mailbox/inbox plus guarded one-thread replies.
CRM means first-party BNA CRM patterns only; no GHL or LeadConnector runtime.

out_of_scope: No bulk broadcast/campaign send in this packet.
No hard-coded physical mailing address or raw private address in tracked source.
No DNS mutation, webhook creation inside Resend dashboard, provider account mutation, credential copy, or secret exposure.
No payment/access grant, Stripe/GreenInvoice mutation, WhatsApp send, Telegram send, Drive write, Vimeo/Zoom action, or public/member-library publication.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector references, or external CRM writes.
No unrelated BNA school, parent, student, provider, platform, or super-admin data in the Rabbi mailbox.
affected_surfaces: Email provider readiness status for mailbox use

inspection_targets: src/lib/integrations/resend-inbound-crm.js already writes recognized One Time inbound messages into bna_communications.
server.js has Resend inbound webhook routes and admin email draft/send routes, but no provider-scoped mailbox API.
public/provider.html has Parent Inquiries and response drafts, but not a real email mailbox.
docs/integrations/RESEND.md documents inbound receiving and CRM routing.
known_blockers: Live production inbound proof depends on RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET and Resend webhook configuration.
Live reply send depends on Resend readiness and explicit confirmation.
Compliance footer mailing address value is runtime-only and not committed.
observed_visual_defects: Provider portal has an Inquiries tray that says drafts do not send email; this does not satisfy the operator's real mailbox request.
Email Review route previews templates but does not show received mail threads.
Provider-facing normal workflow lacks a dedicated, readable email thread view.

expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM means a first-party One Time mailbox attached to scoped contacts and communications: thread list, contact metadata, activity timeline, reply draft/send state, and workspace scoping.
expanded_phrases.multi-million dollar: The mailbox should be credible and polished: clear hierarchy, contained layout, useful states, readable mobile, no debug clutter, and no fake actions.
expanded_phrases.million-dollar: The mailbox must use exact IA, state, action, and evidence requirements instead of a vague visual polish claim.
expanded_phrases.working: Working means received messages load from the scoped backend, selected thread opens, drafts save locally, guarded sends either succeed with readback or return a clear blocker, and errors are visible.
expanded_phrases.configured: Configured means sender, reply-to, inbound webhook, domain, and mailing-address readiness are shown as ready or blocked with owner/next action without exposing secret values.
expanded_phrases.clean: Clean means aligned list/detail layout, readable labels, contained cards, no debug clutter, mobile reflow, clear state messages, and no fake actions.
expanded_phrases.bulk email: Bulk email is not part of this implementation slice; it requires recipient source, unsubscribe/suppression readiness, compliance footer config, seed proof, and a separate approval packet.
expanded_phrases.inbox: Inbox means a list/detail email mailbox for info@onetimeonetime.com, not only template previews or generic inquiry cards.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use first-party BNA CRM patterns only: scoped contact matching, communication timelines, thread detail, local notes/drafts, guarded quick actions, and no GHL/LeadConnector runtime.

requirements.statement: Compile and validate the scoped One Time CRM mailbox MVP packet before product code edits.
requirements.expected_result: PQC packet names exact mailbox routes, role scope, states, actions, data, privacy, external-provider policy, and evidence gates.
acceptance_criteria: Packet validates with npm run pqc:validate.
Packet splits bulk broadcast sending out of scope.
Packet forbids hard-coded private physical mailing address.

requirements.statement: Build the provider-scoped mailbox backend for thread list and thread detail.
requirements.expected_result: Authorized One Time provider sessions can list and open email threads from bna_communications scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
acceptance_criteria: Mailbox API returns no unrelated workspace records.
Thread list includes sender, subject, preview, latest status, date, unread/follow-up signals, and contact metadata where available.
Thread detail includes chronological inbound/outbound messages and attachment metadata without raw secret headers.

requirements.statement: Build the provider portal Mailbox UI.
requirements.expected_result: Provider portal has a Mailbox section with inbox list, selected thread, contact panel, readiness card, and reply composer states.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile layout stacks cleanly with a visible back-to-list/detail pattern.
Loading, empty, populated, filtered-empty, error, blocked setup, preview-only, success-readback, permission-denied, and mobile detail states are represented.

requirements.statement: Build local reply draft and guarded reply-send behavior.
requirements.expected_result: Rabbi can save a draft without sending; send attempts require explicit confirmation and Resend readiness, then log outbound messages into the same thread.
acceptance_criteria: Draft save performs no external write.
Send path uses the existing guarded Resend helper and returns readiness blockers when not configured.
Successful send writes an outbound bna_communications row tied to the thread.

requirements.statement: Expose sender and compliance readiness safely.
requirements.expected_result: Mailbox readiness reports sender, reply-to, domain, inbound webhook, and mailing address configured/missing state without secret or private-address exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Exact mailing address is not committed to tracked source.
UI shows whether mailing address config exists, not the raw value.
Missing setup rows name owner and next action.

criteria: Affected workspace/project are exactly rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
Affected routes are limited to provider portal mailbox and provider mailbox APIs.
Existing current-state code paths for Resend inbound, Resend send, and provider portal were inspected.
External writes are either draft-only or guarded by explicit confirmation and readiness.
Bulk broadcast send is split out of scope.
No product decision is required for local mailbox read/draft implementation.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Open Mailbox before API fetch returns.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Mailbox region has a heading and loading status.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading text is readable and does not trap focus.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: UI renders loading state before mocked mailbox data resolves.

empty.expected_visible_message: No emails have arrived at info@onetimeonetime.com yet.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is inside the mailbox main region.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Empty-state copy is readable and not color-only.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Empty mailbox state distinguishes true empty from loading.

populated.expected_visible_message: Thread list and selected email are visible.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Thread list and detail panel have labels.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Thread cards and reply controls have visible focus and readable labels.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Selecting a thread displays chronological messages.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Search returns no matching scoped threads.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Clear search control is keyboard reachable.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Search filter can be cleared and does not call external providers.

error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error has a labeled status and retry button.
error.accessibility_expectation: Error is visible in text and not color-only.
error.test_smoke_assertion: API error renders retryable error state.

blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Receiving or sending needs setup before live use.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked setup card names owner, reason, and next action.

blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Blocked send returns no external write and clear blocker.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Save a reply draft without sending.

preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Draft saved state appears near the composer.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Draft API returns no_send=true and external_write_performed=false.

success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Success readback is announced and remains in the mailbox region.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Success state is visible and not color-only.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Successful mocked send writes outbound communication with provider message id.

permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Denied state has a heading or status.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: No private data is exposed in denied state.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Unauthorized mailbox calls return no message data.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Mobile thread detail has a heading and back control.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile detail opens and returns to list without layout overflow.

findings.user_impact: Rabbi currently has an inquiry tray and template review, not a real mobile-readable email mailbox.
findings.expected_fix: Create a dedicated mailbox surface with list/detail, readable thread cards, mobile selected-thread state, and guarded reply controls.

requirements: Mailbox region has one clear heading and readable status text.
Thread list items are buttons with accessible labels.
Selected thread state is visible in text, not color-only.
Reply composer textarea, Save Draft, and Send Reply controls have names and focus states.
Mobile detail state has a clear Back to inbox control.
Setup blockers identify owner, reason, and next action in text.
test_expectations: No unlabeled visible controls in the mailbox region.
Keyboard users can tab from thread list to composer controls.
